headline: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia
deck: The U.S. president’s comments leave Colette Kress in interim charge as the board is reported not to be considering a return.
body: The change since the paper’s 16 November coverage is President Donald Trump’s public support for Jensen Huang’s possible return as Nvidia chief executive. Trump said Huang had “learned a big lesson” and that he “would certainly not mind” his reinstatement [E1].

Colette Kress, Nvidia’s executive vice president and chief financial officer, is serving as interim chief executive and will retain both executive roles until the company names a permanent successor [E3].

A person familiar with the board’s thinking told The Associated Press that the board is not currently considering Huang’s return. The BBC reported that Nvidia had dismissed the campaign seeking his reinstatement [E2][E4].
